Esports Helper 0.1.1 introduces a generic gaming identity with a white controller on a dark red background.

- Updated extension name, interface, and documentation.
- Enlarged controller artwork for toolbar visibility.
- Renamed the default match-site shortcut to Match dashboard while preserving customized labels and settings.
- Existing match enhancements and site access restrictions remain in place.

[Get the Esports Helper extension!](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ijoihdmdnameopfehjlbcjlbpmebknfe)

The attached ZIP contains runtime files only. This GitHub release does not publish the Chrome Web Store update; the store listing remains on its previously approved version until that update is submitted and approved.
